Embedding request with explicit encoding_format of float returns float array embeddings

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.EmbeddingRequest{
		Model:          `text-embedding-3-small`,
		Input:          pkg.EmbeddingInput(`Test input`),
		EncodingFormat: ptr(pkg.EmbeddingFormatFloat),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Embed(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data[0].Embedding)
}
```
